general.workspaceNameDescription: Update the name of your workspace.
general.automaticUpdatesDescription: Updates seamlessly occur when the workspace is stopped using the latest template version.
general.hookCanOnlyBeUsedFromWorkspaceSettingsPa: This hook can only be used from a workspace settings page

parameters.title: Workspace parameters
parameters.updateRequiredWarning: The template for this workspace requires automatic updates. Update the workspace to edit parameters.
parameters.ephemeralParametersDescription: These parameters only apply for a single workspace start.

schedule.title: Workspace Schedule
schedule.restartDialogDescription: Restarting the workspace will apply the new schedule.
schedule.autostartDescription: Select the time and days of week on which you want the workspace starting automatically.
schedule.autostartNotAllowed: The template for this workspace does not allow modification of autostart.
schedule.autostopDescription: Set how many hours should elapse after the workspace started before the workspace automatically shuts down. This will be extended by {{duration}} after last activity in the workspace was detected.
schedule.autostopNotAllowed: The template for this workspace does not allow modification of autostop.
schedule.ttlNoShutdown: Your workspace will not automatically shut down.
schedule.ttlShutdownAfter: Your workspace will shut down {{duration}} after its next start.

validation.errorNoDayOfWeek: Must set at least one day of week if autostart is enabled.
validation.errorNoTime: Start time is required when autostart is enabled.
validation.errorTime: Time must be in HH:mm format.
validation.errorNoStop: Time until shutdown must be greater than zero when autostop is enabled.
validation.errorTtlMax: Please enter a limit that is less than or equal to 720 hours (30 days).

sharing.title: Workspace sharing
sharing.description: Workspace sharing allows you to share workspaces with other users and groups.
